h1.en: Power Cell Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump Prints keeps its own figures; Transmission (mechanical device) is only the picture
h1.zh: 电动10系列混凝土泵的动力格子印了什么保留自己的数字，「变速器」只是配图

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Motor Power is 15 kW. An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transmission_(mechanical_device).
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动10系列混凝土泵的动力文字写成：电机功率是15 kW。画面「Check valve」的主体是Inside hastelloy 单向阀, wafer configuration。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transmission_(mechanical_device)。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transmission_(mechanical_device). The picture shows Transmission (mechanical device). Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Motor Power is 15 kW. It does not change this power entry, and a diesel code is not copied onto an electric row. Theoretical Output remains 21 m³/h. Hopper capacity is 0.1 m³. A larger motor entry is not a longer pipeline.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transmission_(mechanical_device)。画面是Transmission (mechanical device)。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动10系列混凝土泵的动力文字写成：电机功率是15 kW。最大骨料粒径 2 cm and below。

body.en: An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. Motor Power is 15 kW. Max. Outlet Pressure remains 23 MPa. Maximum aggregate size is 2 cm and below.
body.zh: 画面「Check valve」的主体是Inside hastelloy 单向阀, wafer configuration。

body.en: A diesel entry names the engine line that is actually shown. Electric drive and diesel drive are different supplies. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not lift kilowatts or an engine code out of that frame. Main-unit weight is 400 kg.
body.zh: 它不改这一格动力，也不会把柴油机代号抄到电动行上。

body.en: The frame “Check valve” shows Inside hastelloy check valve, wafer configuration. Use the label on this sheet, not the neighbouring model's label. If this row has no voltage entry, none is invented. Those entries, when shown, stay in their own columns.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械不从这一帧里提取千瓦或发动机代号。

question.en: What power text does Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump list?
question.zh: 电动10系列混凝土泵的动力文字是什么？

answer.en: Motor Power is 15 kW. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transmission_(mechanical_device).
answer.zh: 电机功率是15 kW。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transmission_(mechanical_device)画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can a diesel code be moved onto this row?
question.zh: 可以把柴油机代号挪到这一行吗？

answer.en: Only if this row already lists it. Otherwise the entry stays as written. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transmission_(mechanical_device).
answer.zh: 只有这一行已经标出了才能算。否则格子保持原样。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transmission_(mechanical_device)画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What are output and pressure on this sheet?
question.zh: 这一页的输送量和压力是多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 21 m³/h. Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transmission_(mechanical_device).
answer.zh: 理论输送量是21 m³/h。最大出口压力是23 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transmission_(mechanical_device)画面里印出的数字。
